title: Ducky's Player Bodies
description: Adds player bodies on death with items and xp.
body:
# Ducky's Player Bodies
## Overview
A mod that spawns a lootable player body on death, preserving your full inventory and XP.

## Features

When you die, a body entity spawns at your death location containing your full inventory, armor, offhand, and XP.

Bodies are **owner-only** for 7 minutes by default, then become lootable by anyone. Bodies persist indefinitely unless despawn is enabled in the config.

## Configuration Commands

You can change settings in-game using `/duckysbodies`

## Supported Versions

**Forge** — Minecraft 1.20.1
